title: Grubhub's $24M FTC settlement is finally reaching diners and drivers | TechCrunch
summary: Well over half a million Grubhub drivers and customers are set to receive a share of $23.8 million following allegations that the food delivery company misled workers about their potential earnings and engaged in other deceptive practices.
